{{Quote|I noticed some thugs hanging around the area recently. I think they call themselves Braggan's Fist. Whatever that means.|[[Edbr Yamagh]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CCFSH" />}}
'''Braggan's Fist''' was a group of thugs that operated in and around the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|core world]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

==History==
[[File:BraggansFistThug-SWG.jpg|thumb|right|100px|A Braggan's Fist thug.]]
{{Quote|They are often loitering around in the slums area.|Edbr Yamagh, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CCFSH" />}}
The organization was founded and led by [[Kal Braggan]], a disgraced [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] officer who had been framed by another CorSec officer, [[Wilfred Quelsh]], for a crime that he didn't commit.<ref name="SWG:CCFSH" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Corellian Medal of Honor]] of [[Lieutenant Colonel/Legends|Lieutenant Colonel]] Wilfred Quelsh was reported stolen. After Quelsh asked an independent agent to investigate the theft, Quelsh's aide [[Edbr Yamagh]] pointed the [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to the thugs of Braggan's Fist, because he suspected their involvement. The spacer tried to make the thugs talk at gunpoint, but they claimed to know nothing. However they let slip that Braggan had been acting odd and had disappeared into hiding. They also revealed the location of [[Braggan's Fist Camp|their main camp]] near Tyrena where the agent found Braggan's [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] and the coordinates of Braggan's hiding place. The agent later discovered that Quelsh had murdered Braggan.<ref name="SWG:CCFSH" />

Around the same time, CorSec [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Sola Hus|Hus]] recruited a spacer to recover some stolen goods from the Braggan's Fist thugs in their camp.<ref name="SWG:RSG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Recovering Stolen Goods|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The members of Braggan's Fist were [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Characters]] (NPCs) in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:CCFSH" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Braggan's Fist was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref> The gang members could be found in the slums of Tyrena and a camp half a kilometer outside of the city. They were part of the quest "[[:w:c:swg:CorSec Case Files: Stolen Honor|CorSec Case Files: Stolen Honor]]" which was part of the [[:w:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy quest line]], the longest quest line in the game.<ref name="SWG:CCFSH" />
